NVML_GPU_OPERATIONAL_EVENT_LOG_LEVEL_ALL.doc: Matches all GPU Operational Event log levels.

NVML_GPU_UTILIZATION_SAMPLES.doc: To represent percent of time during which one or more kernels was executing on the GPU.

NVML_GPU_VIRTUALIZATION_MODE_HOST_VGPU.doc: Device is associated with VGX hypervisor in vGPU mode.

NVML_GPU_VIRTUALIZATION_MODE_HOST_VSGA.doc: Device is associated with VGX hypervisor in vSGA mode.

NVML_GPU_VIRTUALIZATION_MODE_VGPU.doc: Device is associated with vGPU inside virtual machine.

NVML_INFOROM_COUNT.doc: This counts the number of infoROM objects the driver knows about.

NVML_INFOROM_ECC.doc: The ECC object determining the level of ECC support.

NVML_JPG_UTILIZATION_SAMPLES.doc: To represent percent of time during which NVJPG remains busy.

NVML_MEMORY_ERROR_TYPE_CORRECTED.doc:
A memory error that was corrected.

For ECC errors, these are single bit errors For Texture memory, these are errors fixed by resend.

NVML_MEMORY_ERROR_TYPE_UNCORRECTED.doc:
A memory error that was not corrected.

For ECC errors, these are double bit errors For Texture memory, these are errors where the resend fails.

NVML_MEMORY_LOCATION_COUNT.doc: This counts the number of memory locations the driver knows about.

NVML_MEMORY_UTILIZATION_SAMPLES.doc: To represent percent of time during which global (device) memory was being read or written.

NVML_MODULE_POWER_SAMPLES.doc: To represent module power samples for total module starting Grace Hopper.

NVML_NVLINK_TELEMETRY_SAMPLE_TYPE_THROUG.doc: Raw RX flit counter for a single link.
Raw TX flit counter for a single link.

NVML_OFA_UTILIZATION_SAMPLES.doc: To represent percent of time during which NVOFA remains busy.

NVML_PAGE_RETIREMENT_CAUSE_DOUBLE_BIT_EC.doc: Page was retired due to double bit ECC error.

NVML_PAGE_RETIREMENT_CAUSE_MULTIPLE_SING.doc: Page was retired due to multiple single bit ECC error.

NVML_PERF_POLICY_BOARD_LIMIT.doc: How long did the board limit cause the GPU to be below application clocks.

NVML_PERF_POLICY_LOW_UTILIZATION.doc: How long did low utilization cause the GPU to be below application clocks.

NVML_PERF_POLICY_POWER.doc: How long did power violations cause the GPU to be below application clocks.

NVML_PERF_POLICY_RELIABILITY.doc: How long did the board reliability limit cause the GPU to be below application clocks.

NVML_PERF_POLICY_SYNC_BOOST.doc: How long did sync boost cause the GPU to be below application clocks.

NVML_PERF_POLICY_THERMAL.doc: How long did thermal violations cause the GPU to be below application clocks.

NVML_PERF_POLICY_TOTAL_APP_CLOCKS.doc: Total time the GPU was held below application clocks by any limiter (0 - 5 above).

NVML_PERF_POLICY_TOTAL_BASE_CLOCKS.doc: Total time the GPU was held below base clocks.

NVML_POWER_PROFILE_OPERATION_CLEAR.doc: Remove the requested profiles from the existing list of requested profiles.

NVML_POWER_PROFILE_OPERATION_SET.doc: Add the requested profiles to the existing list of requested profiles.

NVML_POWER_PROFILE_OPERATION_SET_AND_OVE.doc: Overwrite the existing list of requested profiles with just the requested profiles.

NVML_PROCESS_MODE_ALL.doc: All processes running on the GPU (compute, graphics, MPS, and other types).

NVML_PROCESS_MODE_MPS.doc: Processes with a MPS (Multi-Process Service) compute context.

NVML_RESTRICTED_API_SET_APPLICATION_CLOC.doc: APIs that change application clocks, see nvmlDeviceSetApplicationsClocks and see nvmlDeviceResetApplicationsClocks. Deprecated, keeping definition for backward compatibility.

NVML_RESTRICTED_API_SET_AUTO_BOOSTED_CLO.doc: APIs that enable/disable Auto Boosted clocks see nvmlDeviceSetAutoBoostedClocksEnabled.

NVML_TEMPERATURE_GPU.doc: Temperature sensor for the GPU die.

NVML_TEMPERATURE_GPU_MAX.doc: Temperature from the hottest part of the GPU die.

NVML_TEMPERATURE_THRESHOLD_ACOUSTIC_CURR.doc: Current temperature that is set as acoustic threshold.

NVML_TEMPERATURE_THRESHOLD_ACOUSTIC_MAX.doc: Maximum GPU temperature that can be set as acoustic threshold.

NVML_TEMPERATURE_THRESHOLD_ACOUSTIC_MIN.doc: Minimum GPU Temperature that can be set as acoustic threshold.

NVML_TEMPERATURE_THRESHOLD_GPS_CURR.doc: Current temperature that is set as gps threshold.

NVML_TEMPERATURE_THRESHOLD_GPU_MAX.doc: GPU Temperature at which the GPU can be throttled below base clock.

NVML_TEMPERATURE_THRESHOLD_MEM_MAX.doc: Memory Temperature at which the GPU will begin SW slowdown.

NVML_TEMPERATURE_THRESHOLD_SHUTDOWN.doc: Temperature at which the GPU will shut down for HW protection.

NVML_TEMPERATURE_THRESHOLD_SLOWDOWN.doc: Temperature at which the GPU will begin HW slowdown.

NVML_THERMAL_COOLER_SIGNAL_NONE.doc: This cooler has no control signal.

NVML_THERMAL_COOLER_SIGNAL_TOGGLE.doc: This cooler can only be toggled either ON or OFF (eg a switch).

NVML_THERMAL_COOLER_SIGNAL_VARIABLE.doc: This cooler’s level can be adjusted from some minimum to some maximum (eg a knob).

NVML_THERMAL_COOLER_TARGET_GPU.doc: This cooler can cool the GPU.

NVML_THERMAL_COOLER_TARGET_GPU_RELATED.doc: This cooler cools all of the components related to its target gpu. GPU_RELATED = GPU | MEMORY | POWER_SUPPLY.

NVML_THERMAL_COOLER_TARGET_MEMORY.doc: This cooler can cool the memory.

NVML_THERMAL_COOLER_TARGET_POWER_SUPPLY.doc: This cooler can cool the power supply.

NVML_THERMAL_TARGET_BOARD.doc: GPU board ambient temperature requires NvPhysicalGpuHandle.

NVML_THERMAL_TARGET_POWER_SUPPLY.doc: GPU power supply temperature requires NvPhysicalGpuHandle.

NVML_THERMAL_TARGET_VCD_BOARD.doc: Visual Computing Device Board temperature requires NvVisualComputingDeviceHandle.

NVML_THERMAL_TARGET_VCD_INLET.doc: Visual Computing Device Inlet temperature requires NvVisualComputingDeviceHandle.

NVML_THERMAL_TARGET_VCD_OUTLET.doc: Visual Computing Device Outlet temperature requires NvVisualComputingDeviceHandle.

NVML_TOTAL_POWER_SAMPLES.doc: To represent total power drawn by GPU.

NVML_VGPU_CAP_EXCLUSIVE_SIZE.doc: vGPU profile cannot run on a GPU alongside other profiles of different size.

NVML_VGPU_CAP_EXCLUSIVE_TYPE.doc: vGPU profile cannot run on a GPU alongside other profiles of different type.

NVML_VGPU_CAP_MULTI_VGPU_EXCLUSIVE.doc: vGPU profile cannot be mixed with other vGPU profiles in same VM.

NVML_VGPU_COMPATIBILITY_LIMIT_GPU.doc: Compatibility is limited by GPU hardware.

NVML_VGPU_COMPATIBILITY_LIMIT_GUEST_DRIV.doc: Compatibility is limited by guest driver version.

NVML_VGPU_COMPATIBILITY_LIMIT_HOST_DRIVE.doc: ompatibility is limited by host driver version.

NVML_VGPU_COMPATIBILITY_LIMIT_OTHER.doc: Compatibility is limited by an undefined factor.

NVML_VGPU_DRIVER_CAP_HETEROGENEOUS_MULTI.doc: Supports mixing of different vGPU profiles within one guest VM.

NVML_VGPU_DRIVER_CAP_WARM_UPDATE.doc: Supports FSR and warm update of vGPU host driver without terminating the running guest VM.

NVML_VGPU_VM_COMPATIBILITY_COLD.doc: vGPU is runnable from a cold / powered-off state (ACPI S5).

NVML_VGPU_VM_COMPATIBILITY_HIBERNATE.doc: vGPU is runnable from a hibernated state (ACPI S4).

NVML_VGPU_VM_COMPATIBILITY_LIVE.doc: vGPU is runnable from a live/paused (ACPI S0).

NVML_VGPU_VM_COMPATIBILITY_SLEEP.doc: vGPU is runnable from a sleeped state (ACPI S3).

NVML_VOLATILE_ECC.doc: Volatile counts are reset each time the driver loads.
